full_judgment:
2. Short facts relevant for disposal of the rule are that the Charbishnopur Union Parishad Office was constructed on 15 decimals of land of BS Khatian No. 5, Dag No. 5228, JL No. 26, Mouza Krisnamongaler Dangi, Upazila-Sadarpur, District-Faridpur. The petitioner gifted 11 (eleven) decimals of land of BS Khatian No. 798, BS Dag No. 5229 by registered gift deed No. 500 dated 27-2-2017 in favour of the said Union Parishad for construction of Union Parishad Office Complex which she got vide deed of exchange being No. 437 of 2017 dated 22-2-2017. After that, the local people filed an application on 13-3-2017 to the respondent Nos. 4 and 5 for construction of the Union Parishad Office Complex at the old site. The local Member of Parliament also issued a letter being No. এম,পি/ফরিদ-৪/২০১৭-০১৫৮৪ dated 22-9-2017 requesting the respondent No. 1 to construct the Union Parishad Office Complex at the old site but the respondent No. 4 without taking any step for construction of the said Union Parishad Office Complex at the old site made recommendation for construction of the Union Parishad Office Complex of the said Union on 25 decimals of land of BS Khatian No. 775, Dag No. 3464 of Mouza-Charbishnapur Bazarikandi. Thereafter, the respondent No.3 by impugned Memo No. ৪৬০০.২৯০০.০১৭.৯৯.০০২.১৬(অংশ-১)৯৮৮ dated 13-12-2017 (Annexure-H) has given administrative approval for construction of Charbishnapur Union Parishad Office Complex on 25 decimals of land of BS Khatian No. 775, BS Dag No. 3464, Mouza- Charbishnapur Bazarikandi, JL No. 22 Upazila-Sadarpur, District-Faridpur. Thereafter the petitioner filed an application on 22-1-2018 to the respondent No.5 for construction of the Union Parished Office Complex at the Old site. 

 3. The respondent No. 6 contested the rule by filing affidavit-in-opposition stating that one Abdul Mannan Chowdhury and Ruhul Amin Chowdhury gifted 25 decimals of land in favour of Charbishnapur Union Parishad vide registered deed No. 1242 dated 22-11-2016 of Mouza-Charbishnapur Bazarikandi, JL No. 22, BS Khatian No. 775, BS Dag No. 3464 for construction of Charbishnapur Union Parishad Office Complex and the said land has been mutated in the name of the said Union Parishad. Thereafter Charbishnapur Union Parishad in its meeting held on 25-1-2017 unanimously decided to construct the Union Parishad Office Complex on 25 decimals of land of Mouza- Charbisnapur Bazarikandi, BS Khatian No. 775, BS Dag No. 3464 and the respondent No. 6 filed an application on 9-2-2017 to the respondent No. 5 for construction of the Union Parishad Office Complex building at the new site following the decision taken in the meeting dated 25-1-2017 of the Union Parishad. He claimed that the site selected by the Union Parishad is the nearest to the Union Land Office, Union Health Complex, Family Planning Centre and Co-operative Society of Freedom Fighters. After submitting the application by respondent No. 6, respondent No. 4 submitted a report making a recommendation for construction of the said Union Parishad Office Complex on 25 decimals of land of Mouza-Charbishnapur Bazarikandi, BS Khatian No. 775, BS Dag 3464. The respondent No. 4 vide Memo No. ০৫.১২.২৯০০.০১০.৩৬.০০৬.১৬.৪৫৩ dated 7-11-2017 (Annexure-viii) also made a recommendation for construction of the said Union Parishad Office Complex at the new site selected by the concerned Union Parishad. The respondent No. 6 also stated that the Union Land Assistant Officer vide letter dated 4-3-2018 informed the respondent No. 5 that 11 decimals of land gifted by the petitioner in favour of the said Union Parishad has not been mutated in the name of the Union Parishad and the said 11 decimals of land was gifted earlier in favour of the office of the Social Welfare by a registered deed. 

 6. Md Syed Nyder Ali, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the respondent No. 6 submits that the Union Parishad in its meeting held on 25-1-2017 unanimously decided to construct the Union Parishad Office Complex on 25 decimals of land of BS Khatian No. 775, Dag 3464, Mouza- Charbishnapur Bazarikandi gifted by Abdul Mannan Chowdhury and Ruhul Amin Chowdhury and the said land was recorded in the name of the said Union Parishad. He further submits that the respondent No. 4 after inspection found that the new site is suitable for construction of Union Parishad Office Complex and after passing the impugned memo the respondent No. 4 visited the approved site and made further recommendation for construction of the Union Parishad Office Complex at the new site following the Paripatra being No. ৪৬.০১৭.০২২.০০.০০.০১১.২০১৩-৬৮৫ তাং ১৬-৯-২০১৩ (Annexure-B). He also submits that the local Union Parishad, the Deputy Commissioner, Faridpur and respondent No.1 are agreeable to construct the said complex at the new site. Therefore, no illegality was committed by respondent No. 1 for giving the approval to construct the Union Parishad Office Complex at the new site. He prayed for discharging the Rule. 

 9. On perusal of the records it appears that the Charbishnapur Union Parishad in its meeting held on 25-1-2017 passed a unanimous resolution (Annexure-VI) for construction of Union Parishad Office Complex on 25 decimals of land of BS Khatian No. 775, Dag No. 3464 of Mouza-Charbishnapur Bazarkandi and thereafter sent a proposal (Annexure-VII series) on 9-2-2017 to respondent No. 5 for construction of the Office Complex at new site and Deputy Director, Local Government, Faridpur after inspection submitted a report on 7-11-2017 (Annexure-VIII) making recommendation for construction of the Union Parishad Complex at new site wherein it has been mentioned that the Union Land Office, Union Health Complex is situated near the proposed site and there is a good communication between the District Headquarter and proposed site. 

 10. On perusal of the records it further appears that old office of the Charbishnapur Union Parishad is situated on 15 decimals of land of BS Khatian No. 5, Dag No. 5228 of Mouza-Krishnamongaler Dangi and by impugned memo dated 13-12-2017 (Annexure-H) approval has been given to construct the Union Parishad Office Complex of the said Union on 25 decimals of land of BS Khatian No. 775, BS Dag No. 3464 Mouza- Charbishnapur Bazarkandi and both the Sites are situated on the opposite corners of the said Union. 

 13. The government passed the impugned memo dated 13-12-2017 (Annexure-H) giving approval for construction of Charbishnapur Union Parishad Office Complex, Upazila Sadarpur, Faridpur on 25 decimals of land of BS Khatian No. 775, Dag No. 3464 of Mouza-Charbishnapur Bazarkandi considering the unanimous resolution dated 25-1-2017 of the Union Parishad (Annexure-VI) and the reports dated 7-11-2017 of the Deputy Commissioner, Faridpur (Annexure-viii). The respondent Nos. 1 and 4 are in full agreement to construct the Union Parishad Office Complex at the new site proposed by the concern Union Parishad.
